purpose: Judge an outcome to be beyond realistic possibility.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
With this budget, completion is out of the question.
It cannot possibly be compared with the technology of that era.
There is no way to know the deepest part of another person’s heart.
restrictions: Often with 望む, 比べる, or 知る.
mistake: This is impossibility, not a recommendation against acting.
